brief.summary: Meshy is an AI 3D generation platform. It turns a sketch, photo or prompt into a textured, rigged, print-ready model in about a minute, sends it into Blender, Unity, Unreal or a slicer, and offers an API, a shared studio workspace and enterprise controls. The SMB push adds a free Meshy Certified program and an AI outreach agent, Myko.
brief.target: Net-new SMB customers across four equally weighted segments: amateurs, individual pros and startups (including print and e-commerce shops), SMB game studios of 10 to 200 people, and large studios and publishers.
brief.proposition: Base meshes in minutes, finished in your tools, and every model stays yours.
brief.tone: Plain, specific and respectful of craft. Talk like a technical artist who has shipped games, not like an AI company. Confident, never hyped. No exclamation marks.
mandatories: Never imply replacing artists, cutting headcount or beating a human modeler.
Promise a hybrid pipeline, never one-click final assets.
Only use claims with proof in the MRD; the blind test, user counts and the 4.7 rating stay out.
Include at least one trust line in every direction: ownership, private by default, or opt out of training.
Never disparage Tripo, Rodin or Hunyuan3D by name.
